name: fuelstation
description: Forecourt furniture — the pumps and the price board. Owns no verbs and no prices of its own: `fill` (fillable) draws fuel from a pump, `fuel` (trucking) fills a rig at one, and the board prints whatever the `fuel.prices` gather hook is told by the systems that actually charge. A station is a place where several unrelated plugins already take money for diesel; this is the sign that says how much.
